text:
Nadia Ortiz: hi team  Cassidy starting today! laptop arrived but MDM asks for an enrollment code, and i need CI deploy token access. who should i poke? also: favorite desk plant recs? :)

Ravi Shah: welcome Nadia!! :tada: i'm your buddy. for CI tokens ping @Morgan Lee and file a short ticket in #help-it. generate SSH key locally (ed25519) and i'll add you to the repo.

Morgan Lee: hey @Nadia  created a ticket for CI token and will attach it to your account once MDM shows enrolled. for MDM code, IT-Bot can provision a one-time code.

IT-Bot: Hello! To request a one-time MDM enrollment code, reply with "request-mdm-code <employee-id>". We issued a code to Morgan; check your DMs.

Cassidy Park: pothos or sansevieria are easy. welcome!

Nadia Ortiz: thanks all  enrolled with the code, SSH key uploaded, and pulled my first repo. excited to be here and to adopt a tiny pothos :seedling:
